descriptions.text: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 6 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room.

All-inclusive rates are available at this hotel. Meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments are included in all-inclusive rates. Charges may be applied for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities.

Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink from the beach bar or one of the 3 poolside bars. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee.

Featured amenities include a business center, limo/town car service, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Dubai? This hotel has 15705 square feet (1459 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 9 meeting rooms. Free valet parking is available onsite.

Make yourself at home in one of the 294 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads.

activities.activityName: Dubai Sky Views Observatory Ticket with Free Glass Slide + Photos
activities.description: Discover the Dubai Sky Views Observatory with its thrilling Glass Slide, a must-visit attraction offering a unique and exhilarating experience in the heart of Dubai. Located atop the Address Sky View Hotel, this tour combines the Observatory, Sky Slide, and Sky Edge Walk for an unforgettable adventure. With your standard Sky View Dubai ticket, you gain access to the Observatory, boasting mesmerizing views of Dubai, and the Sky Slide, a thrilling descent through a transparent glass tube from the 53rd to the 52nd level. Take in panoramic views of iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, and Sheikh Zayed Road as you capture stunning photos on the 25-meter-long glass walkway connecting the twin hotel towers. Don't miss the chance to ride the first-of-its-kind Glass Slide for an adrenaline rush like no other. Book your Dubai Sky Views tour today and prepare to be captivated by the city's breathtaking vistas and unmatched thrills.

inclusions.otherDescription: Get the most compelling views over Dubai’s skyline and beyond as you zoom up 219.5 meters high

itineraryItems.description:
Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, is home to some of the most beautiful monuments and buildings in the country. The latest addition to the city is the Qasr Al Watan. The presidential palace is also known as the newest cultural landmark of the Emirate city. Qasr Al Watan houses the offices of the President, Vice President, and Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi.

Qasr Al Watan is the epitome of beauty, grace, and marvelous architecture. You would get to visit the beautiful rooms of the palace including the library, the Great Hall, the Barza (the royal banquet), etc. You would also be able to attend interactive cultural exhibitions, view rare manuscripts and artifacts, and witness the contribution of Arabs in the fields of humanities, science, literature, and arts. The ticket also gives you the chance to explore the gorgeous gardens that flank the palace.

activities.description:
Yas Island in Abu Dhabi is a popular spot for thrill seekers. It now also caters to families with the addition of KidZania Abu Dhabi. This 60,000 sq. ft. facility is located in Yas Mall, adjacent to attractions like Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, Yas Waterworld, and Warner Bros. KidZania Abu Dhabi is the second KidZania location in the UAE, following the Dubai Mall.

KidZania is a theme park for kids aged 4 to 16 that offers real-life occupations and learning experiences with entertainment.

KidZania Abu Dhabi offers over 60 role-playing activities for kids, allowing them to experience their favorite professions in a miniature city. Kids can earn and spend KidZos, the park's currency, while enjoying their financial independence.

While parents or adults aren't allowed inside the facility, electronic wristbands connect them with their children and trained supervisors are available to help kids navigate the miniature city.

inclusions.otherDescription: A chance for children to develop social skills, creativity, and problem-solving abilities.
Immersive learning and hands-on engagement in various professions and occupations.
admission to KidZania Abu Dhabi's interactive theme park.
Opportunity to participate in over 80 role-playing activities and experiences.

exclusions.otherDescription: All personal expenses spend for shopping, drinks and dining etc on-site during the tour.

itineraryItems.description:
KidZania Abu Dhabi is an impressive and stimulating theme park located in the vibrant Yas Island. Its primary goal is to offer children an immersive learning experience through a wide range of interactive activities. With over 80 role-playing games, kids have the opportunity to explore various professions, such as pilot, shopkeeper, astronaut, doctor, nurse, firefighter, and truck driver, among others. 

This innovative mini city allows children to gain valuable insights into the real world while having fun. They can learn about different professions and how they function, enhancing their social skills, problem-solving abilities, and creativity. The park is designed to cater to children aged between 4 to 16 years, with activities tailored to suit different age groups. 

At KidZania Abu Dhabi, parents can relax at the lounge while their kids engage in fun and educational activities. The park's staff ensures the safety and well-being of every child.
itineraryItems.name: KidZania Abu Dhabi
